title: Weighted linear stability of the hexagonal Abrikosov lattice in the lowest Landau level
difficulty_reason: The authors develop the strip Hilbert basis and cubic coupling, derive the hexagonal linearized Fourier matrix, establish the sign and endpoint asymptotics of its theta-function eigenvalue, and use the explicit propagator with compensating singular weights to obtain estimates uniform in time. This source-local spectral analysis is retained in full. The result is conditional on the weighted initial norms; it is not an unconditional nonlinear or unweighted L2 stability assertion.
